description: Read up to 10 web pages as clean text in one call: title, description and readable body, with the final URL. A plain fetch (no JavaScript); for a rendered page use page_extract. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: web_read
